name: Click Before Frames
description: Adaptive before-frame click timing with presets, per-input leads and EN/ID support. / Waktu klik sebelum frame adaptif dengan preset, jeda per-input, dan dukungan EN/ID.

issues.info: Report bugs in English or Bahasa Indonesia / Laporkan bug dalam bahasa Inggris atau Indonesia.

language.name: Language / Bahasa
language.description:
EN: Language used for in-game labels, diagnostics and popups.
ID: Bahasa yang dipakai untuk label, diagnostik, dan popup di dalam game.

Settings in the mod menu are written in both languages / Pengaturan di menu mod ditulis dalam dua bahasa.

soft-toggle.name: Disable Mod / Nonaktifkan Mod
soft-toggle.description:
EN: Disable Before Frame without restarting Geometry Dash. This does not disable Physics Bypass if you enabled it!
ID: Nonaktifkan Before Frame tanpa memulai ulang Geometry Dash. Ini TIDAK menonaktifkan Physics Bypass jika sudah diaktifkan!

before-frame.name: Before Frame Mode / Mode Before Frame
before-frame.description:
EN: Pull clicks earlier (before the visual frame) instead of applying them at their exact sub-frame position. Turn this off for classic between-frames precision.
ID: Geser klik lebih awal (sebelum frame visual), bukan pada posisi sub-frame persisnya. Matikan untuk presisi klasik di antara frame.

preset.name: Preset / Preset
preset.description:
EN: Quick profile. Custom = use the settings below. Vanilla = no lead. One Step = one real physics step. Half Frame / Full Frame = 50% / 100% of the measured frame interval (Full Frame puts every click on the first step).
ID: Profil cepat. Custom = pakai pengaturan di bawah. Vanilla = tanpa jeda. One Step = satu step fisika asli. Half Frame / Full Frame = 50% / 100% dari interval frame terukur (Full Frame menaruh semua klik di step pertama).

lead-mode.name: Lead Mode / Mode Jeda
lead-mode.description:
EN: Auto = lead follows one real physics step of the current frame (adapts to FPS, timewarp, lag and Physics Bypass). Manual = use the millisecond value below. Only used when Preset = Custom.
ID: Auto = jeda mengikuti satu step fisika asli frame saat ini (menyesuaikan FPS, timewarp, lag, dan Physics Bypass). Manual = pakai nilai milidetik di bawah. Hanya dipakai saat Preset = Custom.

before-frame-lead.name: Manual Lead (ms) / Jeda Manual (ms)
before-frame-lead.description:
EN: Milliseconds each click is pulled earlier, used with Preset = Custom + Lead Mode = Manual. 0 = classic; 4.17 = one 240 TPS step at 60 FPS; 16.67 = a whole 60 FPS frame (all clicks on the first step).
ID: Milidetik klik digeser lebih awal, dipakai saat Preset = Custom + Mode Jeda = Manual. 0 = klasik; 4,17 = satu step 240 TPS pada 60 FPS; 16,67 = satu frame penuh 60 FPS (semua klik di step pertama).

separate-leads.name: Separate Leads / Jeda Terpisah
separate-leads.description:
EN: Give releases (orb holds, dash orb releases) and Player 2 in duals their own lead scale. Keeps press timing unchanged.
ID: Beri skala jeda tersendiri untuk pelepasan (tahan orb, dash orb) dan Player 2 saat dual. Waktu penekanan tetap tidak berubah.

release-lead-scale.name: Release Lead (%) / Jeda Lepas (%)
release-lead-scale.description:
EN: Lead scale for release inputs. 0% = releases stay at their exact sub-frame time (useful for orb holds); 100% = same as presses.
ID: Skala jeda untuk input lepas. 0% = pelepasan tetap di waktu sub-frame persisnya (berguna untuk tahan orb); 100% = sama seperti penekanan.

p2-lead-scale.name: P2 Lead (%) / Jeda P2 (%)
p2-lead-scale.description:
EN: Lead scale for Player 2 inputs (duals). 0% = P2 keeps exact sub-frame timing.
ID: Skala jeda untuk input Player 2 (dual). 0% = P2 tetap memakai waktu sub-frame persisnya.

show-indicator.name: Show Status Label / Tampilkan Label Status
show-indicator.description:
EN: Show a small localized label with the active mode and effective lead while playing.
ID: Tampilkan label kecil sesuai bahasa pilihan, berisi mode aktif dan jeda efektif saat bermain.

show-debug-overlay.name: Show Debug Overlay / Tampilkan Overlay Debug
show-debug-overlay.description:
EN: Add measured frame time, current physics step, clicks moved to the first step and total latency saved. Also used to calibrate Auto/Manual lead.
ID: Tambahkan interval frame terukur, step fisika saat ini, jumlah klik yang pindah ke step pertama, dan total latensi yang dihemat. Berguna juga untuk kalibrasi jeda Auto/Manual.

safe-mode.name: Safe Mode / Mode Aman
safe-mode.description:
EN: Disable progress and stats on rated levels.
ID: Nonaktifkan progres dan statistik pada level ber-rating.

click-on-steps.name: Click on Steps / Klik per Step
click-on-steps.description:
EN: Only register inputs with 240 TPS precision. Should have identical physics to vanilla; Before Frame leads are disabled here.
ID: Hanya catat input dengan presisi 240 TPS. Seharusnya fisikanya sama dengan vanilla; jeda Before Frame dimatikan di sini.

mouse-fix.name: Reduce Mouse Lag / Kurangi Lag Mouse
mouse-fix.description:
EN: Reduce lag when using high polling rate mice. Experimental, may break things.
ID: Kurangi lag saat memakai mouse dengan polling rate tinggi. Eksperimental, bisa menimbulkan masalah.

precision-fix.name: Precision Fix / Perbaikan Presisi
precision-fix.description:
EN: Improve input precision by preventing framerate desync. Experimental, may break things.
ID: Tingkatkan presisi input dengan mencegah desinkronisasi framerate. Eksperimental, bisa menimbulkan masalah.

physics-bypass.name: Enable Physics Bypass / Aktifkan Physics Bypass
physics-bypass.description:
EN: Reduces stuttering on some FPS values. Active even if "Disable Mod" is checked. THIS WILL ALTER PHYSICS AND MAY BREAK SOME LEVELS! DON'T USE THIS IF YOUR LIST/LEADERBOARD BANS PHYSICS BYPASS!
ID: Mengurangi stutter pada sebagian nilai FPS. Tetap aktif walaupun "Nonaktifkan Mod" dicentang. INI MENGUBAH FISIKA DAN BISA MERUSAK BEBERAPA LEVEL! JANGAN PAKAI JIKA LIST/LEADERBOARD MELARANG PHYSICS BYPASS!

bypass-mode.name: Physics Bypass Mode / Mode Physics Bypass
bypass-mode.description:
EN: 2.2 mode = as few collision checks per frame as possible (minimum 240 checks per second). 2.1 mode = 4 collision checks per frame at 60 FPS or above.
ID: Mode 2.2 = pemeriksaan tabrakan seminimal mungkin per frame (minimal 240 pemeriksaan per detik). Mode 2.1 = 4 pemeriksaan tabrakan per frame pada 60 FPS ke atas.

wine-workaround.name: Wine Workaround / Solusi Wine
wine-workaround.description:
EN: Wine doesn't let you read keyboard input between frames, so this is a workaround. Only disable if you have issues (and don't play with keyboard if you disable it).
ID: Wine tidak mengizinkan input keyboard dibaca di antara frame, jadi ini solusinya. Matikan hanya jika bermasalah (dan jangan main dengan keyboard jika dimatikan).

right-click.name: Right Click P2 / Klik Kanan P2
right-click.description:
EN: Use right click for player 2 jump.
ID: Pakai klik kanan untuk lompatan player 2.
